gloss_en: Complete honor/glory (kavod bi-shelemut) — the perfected, unblemished honor of God, attained when a person utterly nullifies his own honor and arrogance (holding himself as nothing) and guards the covenant; this perfected divine glory is what enables illuminating speech (Likutey Moharan I:11). Distinct from mere human honor, from כָּבֵד ('heavy', as in kevad peh), and from the liver (kaved).
